vsm2.19:16.1: Aparampi catubbidhaṃ kammaṃ – janakaṃ, upatthambhakaṃ, upapīḷakaṃ, upaghātakanti.
vsm2.19:16.2: Tattha janakaṃ nāma kusalampi hoti akusalampi.
vsm2.19:16.4: Upatthambhakaṃ pana vipākaṃ janetuṃ na sakkoti, aññena kammena dinnāya paṭisandhiyā janite vipāke uppajjamānakasukhadukkhaṃ upatthambheti, addhānaṃ pavatteti.
vsm2.19:16.5: Upapīḷakaṃ aññena kammena dinnāya paṭisandhiyā janite vipāke uppajjamānakasukhadukkhaṃ pīḷeti bādhati, addhānaṃ pavattituṃ na deti.
vsm2.19:16.6: Upaghātakaṃ pana sayaṃ kusalampi akusalampi samānaṃ aññaṃ dubbalakammaṃ ghātetvā tassa vipākaṃ paṭibāhitvā attano vipākassa okāsaṃ karoti.
vsm2.19:16.7: Evaṃ pana kammena kate okāse taṃ vipākaṃ uppannaṃ nāma vuccati.
vsm2.19:17.1: Iti imesaṃ dvādasannaṃ kammānaṃ kammantarañceva vipākantarañca buddhānaṃ kammavipākañāṇasseva yāthāvasarasato pākaṭaṃ hoti, asādhāraṇaṃ sāvakehi.
vsm2.19:17.2: Vipassakena pana kammantarañca vipākantarañca ekadesato jānitabbaṃ.
vsm2.19:17.4: Iti imaṃ dvādasavidhaṃ kammaṃ kammavaṭṭe pakkhipitvā evaṃ eko kammavaṭṭavipākavaṭṭavasena nāmarūpassa paccayapariggahaṃ karoti.
vsm2.19:18.1: So evaṃ kammavaṭṭavipākavaṭṭavasena paccayato nāmarūpassa pavattiṃ disvā ‘‘yathā idaṃ etarahi, evaṃ atītepi addhāne kammavaṭṭavipākavaṭṭavasena paccayato pavattittha, anāgatepi kammavaṭṭavipākavaṭṭavaseneva paccayato pavattissatī’’ti.
vsm2.19:18.2: Iti kammañceva kammavipāko ca, kammavaṭṭañca vipākavaṭṭañca, kammapavattañca vipākapavattañca, kammasantati ca vipākasantati ca, kiriyā ca kiriyāphalañca.
vsm2.19:19.1: Tassevaṃ samanupassato yā sā pubbantādayo ārabbha ‘‘ahosiṃ nu kho aha’’ntiādinā nayena vuttā soḷasavidhā vicikicchā, sā sabbā pahīyati.
vsm2.19:19.3: So neva kāraṇato uddhaṃ kārakaṃ passati, na vipākappavattito uddhaṃ vipākapaṭisaṃvedakaṃ.
vsm2.19:19.4: Kāraṇe pana sati ‘‘kārako’’ti, vipākappavattiyā sati ‘‘paṭisaṃvedako’’ti samaññāmattena paṇḍitā voharanticcevassa sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ hoti.
vsm2.19:20.4:
‘‘Diṭṭhibandhanabaddhā te, taṇhāsotena vuyhare;
Taṇhāsotena vuyhantā, na te dukkhā pamuccare.
vsm2.19:20.5:
‘‘Evametaṃ abhiññāya, bhikkhu buddhassa sāvako;
Gambhīraṃ nipuṇaṃ suññaṃ, paccayaṃ paṭivijjhati.
vsm2.19:20.6:
‘‘Kammaṃ natthi vipākamhi, pāko kamme na vijjati;
Aññamaññaṃ ubho suññā, na ca kammaṃ vinā phalaṃ.
vsm2.19:20.7:
‘‘Yathā na sūriye aggi, na maṇimhi na gomaye;
Na tesaṃ bahi so atthi, sambhārehi ca jāyati.
vsm2.19:20.8:
‘‘Tathā na anto kammassa, vipāko upalabbhati;
Bahiddhāpi na kammassa, na kammaṃ tattha vijjati.
vsm2.19:20.9:
‘‘Phalena suññaṃ taṃ kammaṃ, phalaṃ kamme na vijjati;
Kammañca kho upādāya, tato nibbattate phalaṃ.
vsm2.19:20.10:
‘‘Na hettha devo brahmā vā, saṃsārassatthikārako;
Suddhadhammā pavattanti, hetusambhārapaccayā’’ti.
vsm2.19:21.1: Tassevaṃ kammavaṭṭavipākavaṭṭavasena nāmarūpassa paccayapariggahaṃ katvā tīsu addhāsu pahīnavicikicchassa sabbe atītānāgatapaccuppannadhammā cutipaṭisandhivasena viditā honti,
vsm2.19:22.1: So evaṃ pajānāti – ye atīte kammapaccayā nibbattā khandhā, te tattheva niruddhā,
vsm2.19:22.2: atītakammapaccayā pana imasmiṃ bhave aññe nibbattā, atītabhavato imaṃ bhavaṃ āgato ekadhammopi natthi,
vsm2.19:22.3: imasmimpi bhave kammapaccayena nibbattā khandhā nirujjhissanti, punabbhave aññe nibbattissanti,
vsm2.19:22.4: imamhā bhavā punabbhavaṃ ekadhammopi na gamissati.
vsm2.19:22.5: Apica kho yathā na ācariyamukhato sajjhāyo antevāsikassa mukhaṃ pavisati, na ca tappaccayā tassa mukhe sajjhāyo na vattati,
vsm2.19:22.6: na dūtena mantodakaṃ pītaṃ rogino udaraṃ pavisati, na ca tassa tappaccayā rogo na vūpasammati,
vsm2.19:22.7: na mukhe maṇḍanavidhānaṃ ādāsatalādīsu mukhanimittaṃ gacchati, na ca tattha tappaccayā maṇḍanavidhānaṃ na paññāyati,
vsm2.19:22.8: na ekissā vaṭṭiyā dīpasikhā aññaṃ vaṭṭiṃ saṅkamati, na ca tattha tappaccayā dīpasikhā na nibbattati,
vsm2.19:22.9: evameva na atītabhavato imaṃ bhavaṃ, ito vā punabbhavaṃ koci dhammo saṅkamati,
vsm2.19:22.10: na ca atītabhave khandhāyatanadhātupaccayā idha, idha vā khandhāyatanadhātupaccayā punabbhave khandhāyatanadhātuyo na nibbattantīti.
vsm2.19:23.1:
Yatheva cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, manodhātuanantaraṃ;
Na ceva āgataṃ nāpi, na nibbattaṃ anantaraṃ.
vsm2.19:23.2:
Tatheva paṭisandhimhi, vattate cittasantati;
Purimaṃ bhijjate cittaṃ, pacchimaṃ jāyate tato.
vsm2.19:23.3:
Tesaṃ antarikā natthi, vīci tesaṃ na vijjati;
Na cito gacchati kiñci, paṭisandhi ca jāyatīti.
vsm2.19:24.1: Evaṃ cutipaṭisandhivasena viditasabbadhammassa sabbākārena nāmarūpassa paccayapariggahañāṇaṃ thāmagataṃ hoti,
vsm2.19:24.3: Na kevalañca sā eva, ‘‘satthari kaṅkhatī’’ti (dha. sa. 1008) ādinayappavattā aṭṭhavidhāpi kaṅkhā pahīyatiyeva,
vsm2.19:25.1: Evaṃ nānānayehi nāmarūpapaccayapariggahaṇena tīsu addhāsu kaṅkhaṃ vitaritvā ṭhitaṃ ñāṇaṃ kaṅkhāvitaraṇavisuddhīti veditabbaṃ.
vsm2.19:26.1: Vuttañhetaṃ – ‘‘Avijjā paccayo, saṅkhārā paccayasamuppannā. Ubhopete dhammā paccayasamuppannāti paccayapariggahe paññā dhammaṭṭhitiñāṇa’’nti (paṭi. ma. 1.46).
vsm2.19:26.2: ‘‘Aniccato manasikaronto katame dhamme yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati, kathaṃ sammādassanaṃ hoti, kathaṃ tadanvayena sabbe saṅkhārā aniccato sudiṭṭhā honti, kattha kaṅkhā pahīyati?
vsm2.19:26.3: Dukkhato…pe… anattato manasikaronto katame dhamme yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati…pe… kattha kaṅkhā pahīyatīti?
vsm2.19:26.4: ‘‘Aniccato manasikaronto nimittaṃ yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati, tena vuccati sammādassanaṃ. Evaṃ tadanvayena sabbe saṅkhārā aniccato sudiṭṭhā honti. Ettha kaṅkhā pahīyati.
vsm2.19:26.5: Dukkhato manasikaronto pavattaṃ yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati…pe… anattato manasikaronto nimittañca pavattañca yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati, tena vuccati sammādassanaṃ.
vsm2.19:26.6: Evaṃ tadanvayena sabbe dhammā anattato sudiṭṭhā honti. Ettha kaṅkhā pahīyati.
vsm2.19:26.7: ‘‘Yañca yathābhūtañāṇaṃ yañca sammādassanaṃ yā ca kaṅkhāvitaraṇā, ime dhammā nānatthā ceva nānābyañjanā ca, udāhu ekatthā byañjanameva nānanti?
vsm2.19:26.8: Yañca yathābhūtañāṇaṃ yañca sammādassanaṃ yā ca kaṅkhāvitaraṇā, ime dhammā ekatthā, byañjanameva nāna’’nti (paṭi. ma. 1.227).
vsm2.19:27.1: Iminā pana ñāṇena samannāgato vipassako buddhasāsane laddhassāso laddhapatiṭṭho niyatagatiko cūḷasotāpanno nāma hoti.
vsm2.19:27.2:
Tasmā bhikkhu sadā sato, nāmarūpassa sabbaso;
Paccaye pariggaṇheyya, kaṅkhāvitaraṇatthikoti.
vsm2.19:27.3:
Iti sādhujanapāmojjatthāya kate visuddhimagge
Paññābhāvanādhikāre
Kaṅkhāvitaraṇavisuddhiniddeso nāma
Ekūnavīsatimo paricchedo.
